purpose: Exchange these with an opponent before a counted match. Both sides run their own commit function over each record and nonce; a mismatch on any line means the two implementations would call an honest match tampered.
generated_by: A standalone transcription of the rulebook's commit(), importing neither agent. A fixture produced by the code under test would prove only that the code equals itself.

vectors.name: minimal
vectors.why: The smallest record the formula accepts; catches separator and sort errors.

vectors.name: full_step_record

vectors.name: barrier_placed
vectors.why: A cop turn that seals a cell; pins how a position serialises.
